# method-presentation

## Variables

### resultRows

```ts
const resultRows: ResultRowCodec;
```

The shared result row's decoder and JSON boundary, for
`defineAppMethod({ present: { verb, row, rows: resultRows } })`. Only backends
that present import this module, so the rest carry no decoder.
